gates.name: validity_and_leakage
gates.pass_rule: all metrics finite, zero charged budget violations, zero hidden-state leakage, and no analytic risk copied into observed MSE
gates.scope: all generated rows plus static source/runtime audit

gates.name: below_B_N_fallback
gates.pass_rule: learning_aware fallback fraction equals 1 exactly by deterministic runtime path audit

gates.name: above_B_S_qualification
gates.pass_rule: 100% of paths satisfy frozen probe, delay, dual-budget, epsilon_safe, and commit-reserve qualification predicates

gates.name: high_regime_gain
gates.pass_rule: all cells must have positive analytic expected paired gain direction; only the outcome-free practical-effect subset with analytic relative gain >=0.02 is required to pass the 2% practical-effect claim and simultaneous lower-bound calibration
gates.scope: all theorem-scope above_bs high-regime cells, with practical-effect subset reported separately

gates.name: low_regime_safety
gates.pass_rule: mandatory theorem/runtime compliance audit for epsilon_safe; empirical CI calibration is reported as calibration and may not be an impossible per-cell pass/fail gate

gates.name: directional_identification_theorem_runtime_audit
gates.pass_rule: frozen bidirectional test thresholds are used, both directional analytic bounds are <=0.025, runtime likelihood/stopping/q/b/delay/budget path equals manifest, zero threshold mismatch, and zero hidden-state leakage
gates.scope: all theorem-scope above_bs cells, low-to-high and high-to-low separately

gates.name: directional_identification_empirical_calibration
gates.pass_rule: one-sided exact binomial/Clopper-Pearson simultaneous aggregate directional upper bound <=0.025; any single-cell observed error rate >0.10 triggers failure or manual implementation audit
gates.scope: all preregistered above_bs seed blocks aggregated by direction, with per-cell intervals reported

gates.name: break_even_bracket
gates.pass_rule: at least 0.75 of base scenarios place first registered positive paired mean gain in closed [B_N,B_S]

gates.name: novelty_learning_value
gates.pass_rule: subset must be nonempty; within it, learning_aware must beat information_only by >=0.03 relative with positive simultaneous lower-bound calibration and no charged-violation advantage; identical-path cells are reported but excluded from the novelty effect requirement
gates.scope: learning-value-active delayed dual-budget subset defined before outcomes

gates.name: delay_mechanism
gates.pass_rule: no-delay ablation must have worse intended plan or worse oracle regret only where planning paths differ; identical-path cells receive consistency checks only

gates.name: dual_budget_mechanism
gates.pass_rule: single-budget ablations must ignore the corresponding budget and produce a different intended plan before worse-outcome claims are tested; nonbinding/identical cells are consistency-only

gates.name: exp015a_freeze
gates.pass_rule: EXP-015A remains 7/8 failure; threshold 0.80 and observed 0.777778 are unchanged

gates.name: reproducibility
gates.pass_rule: core raw CSV, aggregate CSV, gate JSON, metadata JSON, and configuration hash reproduce byte-for-byte
gates.scope: clean rerun with identical pilot seeds and committed configuration

progression: All revised mandatory gates must pass. There is no aggregate k-of-n override.
